description: Pitch deck outline — Investor pitch deck outline from a company description (required) with optional stage (default seed), raise, audience and facts (your real traction numbers - the only numbers the model may use). Returns 10-13 slides (type, title, one-sentence headline, up to 4 bullets, visual, speaker notes), likely investor questions with answers, weak spots and markdown. Offline checks: missing standard slides, placeholders to fill, any number in the deck that does not appear in your input (unverifiedNumbers), label-style headlines, verdict READY TO DESIGN/REVIEW NUMBERS/INCOMPLETE. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
